description: Save the captions of a video as srt, vtt, ass, ttml, sbv, lrc, csv, txt, json, markdown or the original file the site serves, to a folder on this machine; returns the path. offsetSec retimes the cues, maxLineChars and maxLines reflow them, and secondary adds a second language under each caption. Works for every source vid2context reads, through its transcript pipeline (no yt-dlp needed), with yt-dlp as a second path; for a video without captions, mode auto (default) transcribes the audio with speech-to-text. languages: one or several codes, or ["all"] for every track; several files come as one .zip. Files go to dir, else VID2CONTEXT_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else ~/Downloads/vid2context.

allowAuto.description: Accept the platform's automatic captions. Default true

allowTranslated.description: Accept the platform's machine translation. Default true

dir.description: Folder to save to: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the default folder

format.description: srt, vtt, ass, ttml, sbv, lrc, csv, txt, json, markdown, original (default srt; original keeps the site's file)

languages.description: Language codes, e.g. ["en","de"], or ["all"]. Default: the spoken language

maxLineChars.description: Longest caption line in characters (cue formats, default 42)

mode.description: auto (captions, else speech-to-text; default), captions (never transcribe), stt (always transcribe)

offsetSec.description: Shift every cue by this many seconds (negative: earlier); timed formats only

secondary.description: A second language shown under each caption, e.g. "de" (bilingual formats)

timestamps.description: txt only: one "[m:ss] line" per caption

url.description: Video URL, YouTube id or local file path

zip.description: Return a .zip even for one file

name: download_captions
title: Download captions or subtitles
